scenes.text: Imagine driving deep into a desolate Mexican desert, and suddenly, your car radio goes completely dead, your smartphone loses all connection, and your navigation compass starts spinning around uncontrollably.

You have officially entered the terrifying Zone of Silence, a truly bizarre patch of barren land where electromagnetic signals and radio waves simply refuse to travel, leaving the world's top scientists completely baffled.

This mysterious hotspot actively pulls heavy, metallic meteorites right out of the night sky, grows mutated alien-looking plants, and locals frequently report seeing glowing, unidentified flying objects hovering above the lonely sand dunes.

While some geologists believe massive underground magnetic iron deposits are messing with our modern technology, others swear it is an active alien portal, so write your wildest theory in the comments and hit follow!

meta.title: The terrifying place on Earth where all technology instantly dies #shorts
